name: Fritz be Nimble - LEGO IDEAs competition entry, Nov 2021
author: SketchyDragonStudios
description:
[NB: If the character gets stuck, keeping running into an obstruction for 7s to reset the level.]
The king has locked his keys in the castle and he and the army are stuck outside being attacked by the automated defences. They need someone nimble to get inside, disable the defences, and open the gate! Are you up for it?

Control: Space bar (Tap or hold)
- To run: Hold
- To jump: Run at least 1 square then tap immediately
- To double jump: Run at least 2 squares, then tap once to jump, and again to jump in the air
- To turn: Slow down and tap when on a Direction Tile
- Action: Slow down and tap when on an Action Tile
